decisions.reason: The no-border decision also affects the Zebra print, but its existing message-34 MODIFY already records both removal of the border and extension of the repeat to the edge.
The no-border instruction concerns the Zebra and Weave repeat prints. The client separately confirms the 7 cm and 17 cm border measurements for the block-colour pareos.
Changing the Basket Weave edge treatment does not alter the production-ready file, colour-calibration, fabric, or ICC-profile requirements.
The no-border instruction applies to the repeat prints, while the same message expressly retains the 7 cm and 17 cm border measurements for the block-colour pareos.
The Basket Weave border removal does not change the independently confirmed 1.5 cm seam allowance or its rolled-hem purpose.
The edge-treatment decision does not alter the requirement to document final CMYK values and closest Pantone equivalents.
